description: Pak Elektron Limited is a Pakistani manufacturer of home appliances and electrical power equipment, established in 1956 and part of the Saigol Group since 1978. The company runs two divisions: Appliances, which makes refrigerators, air conditioners, washing machines, microwave ovens and LED televisions under the PEL brand, and Power, which produces transformers, switchgear and energy meters for utilities and industry.
